text:
Ashley: heads-up — customer reported double token charging on retried tool calls. /cc @billing
Devon: which customer? any logs?
Ashley: acct=acme-inc key=org_123. They retried after a 502 from eu-region and got charged for both attempts.
Jon: quick Q — do we currently distinguish prompt vs completion attribution for retries in billing? I thought completions only counted on success.
Maria: router note: when we auto-retry across hosts we create a new internal request id. Both attempts emit usage events to the ingestion pipeline. Prefix cache didn't short-circuit because different host + different request id.
Len: billing: we dedupe only by request_id. If two different ids show up we count both. Tool calls are billed as separate events so retries will double-bill tools too.
Ashley: paste of customer logs they sent:
```
INFO request=r_abc attempt=1 model=gpt-x prompt_tokens=210 completion_tokens=120 tools_called=1 status=502
INFO request=r_def attempt=2 model=gpt-x prompt_tokens=210 completion_tokens=118 tools_called=1 status=200
```
Devon: that shows prompt tokens repeated and completion tokens logged twice (slightly diff because second truncated).
Maria: the runtime flushes partial completions on error which still emit completion token metrics even when status!=200. So both attempts produce completion metrics.
Jon: root cause seems to be two things: router generates new ids for retries and usage events don't include an original request id or client idempotency key. Billing can't tell these are the same logical call.
Ashley: proposed mitigations:
- router should propagate X-Client-Idempotency (if client provided) and attach original_request_id for internal retries
- mark retry attempts with retry=true in usage events
- billing dedupe by (org, idempotency_key, model, minute-window) and ignore non-final attempts when a final success shows up within window
- console: add "retry token delta" chart per API key so we can spot regressions
Devon: one caveat — if a client intentionally replays same idempotency_key for a new semantic call we might undercount. But that's expected idempotency behavior. Need to document.
Maria: short mitigation we can ship fast: always emit retry=true tag on retried attempts + include original_request_id in usage event. Billing can then quickly ignore retry=true unless no final event appears after 30s.
Len: that rapid approach works for credits. For a durable fix we should implement billing-side dedupe by idempotency_key as you suggested and update the ingestion pipeline to prefer final_success events. Also need an admin tool to run credits for affected window (suggest since 2026-02-01).
infra-bot: deployment planned: router/propagate-idempotency v2 -> canary @ 2026-03-18T22:00Z
billing-bot: created BILL-432: dedupe-by-idempotency_key + admin credit UI + retry-rate dashboard
Ashley: I'll draft a customer-facing incident note and propose credits if billing calc confirms double-billing. :thumbsup:
Jon: I'll pick up the router changes (propagate original_request_id + forward X-Client-Idempotency).
Devon: I'll own the billing dedupe and admin credit UI.
Maria: I'll add retry=true and original_request_id to usage schema and update runtime to populate original_request_id on internal retries.
Len: I'll prepare credit calculation script and ops runbook for handling customer outreach.
Ashley: thanks all — please add PR links to BILL-432 and update this thread when canary metrics look good.
Devon: will do, will also add an instrumentation spike to measure how often retries produce completion tokens vs just prompt tokens.
Maria: quick note: we should also surface retry rate in per-key usage alerts so support can proactively detect noisy keys.
Len: agreed. I'll add an alert template to the runbook.
Ashley: perfect. closing loop in BILL-432.
